task: Immutable high-poly hearth cottage: two reversible Blender UV-aware 60K exterior LOD trials

control.observed_failure: Root's four actual 1024px views retain front window detail but show red atlas-color triangles on rear/side cream plaster and white roof points.

adopted_38021_triangle_reference.same_view_evidence: Both preview reports use 1024px, az038/128/218/308, elevation22 and yaw0; fitted presentation scale differs by 0.17 percent because GLB bounds differ.
adopted_38021_triangle_reference.observed_baseline_defects: Front and rear teal shutters show broken teal/white fragments, ground-floor window frames tear into the stone, and the right-front flower box is degraded. Rear and side plaster, window surrounds and shutter silhouettes are less complete than the 60K rebake.
adopted_38021_triangle_reference.comparison_decision: Root reviewed all four adopted 38K and all four 60K fixed rebake views; the 60K variant is a substantial whole-house improvement despite a smaller chimney-neighbor roof white spot. Approved as an isolated one-cottage near-world A/B candidate, not for main adoption yet.

measured_corner_uv_topology.tool_semantics: Blender 5.2 Collapse uses vertex-group weights to influence collapsing; UV/Seam Delimit belongs to Planar dissolve, not Collapse. Higher weights favor collapse, so true measured seam endpoints received lower weight than interior vertices.

candidate1.method: Measured per-corner UV discontinuities from glTF; interior vertices Collapse group weight1, seam endpoints low nonzero weight0.03, factor5, target60000
candidate1.view_assessment: Front roof/window detail is more coherent than the 40K control; red triangles on rear cream plaster are greatly reduced. Black texture pulling remains under the rear timber band and a small rear roof white speck remains, so the four-view no-color-contamination criterion fails.

failed_strict_zero_seam_build.assessment: A true zero/unassigned seam group could not reach the 60K target; Blender process returned 0 despite script assertion, so stderr and missing output are the reliable failure evidence.

candidate2.method: Smart UV Project on candidate1 60K geometry, new 4096px color atlas, Cycles DIFFUSE COLOR-only selected-to-active bake from immutable 1.63M source
candidate2.material_tradeoff: The source metallic-roughness and normal images remain preserved in immutable source; only base color is rebaked on this candidate. Candidate roughness is a matte constant0.78 and metallic0, so same-camera visual review must decide whether light response is suitable.
candidate2.view_assessment: Against the actually adopted 38,021-triangle Meshy LOD0 at matching az038/128/218/308, doors, teal shutter silhouettes, window frames, flower boxes and rear plaster are markedly more complete. White color pick-up persists on roof tiles immediately beside the chimney in az128/az218; the pristine high-poly reference has no such marks. Root approved isolated real-world near-camera A/B, but not main adoption.
candidate2.preserved_first_bake: tmp/floor1-art-20260916/uv-preserving-lod/candidate2-first-bake-preserved/ (first model, texture, script and 4 actual angles)

failed_gpu_enumeration.assessment: Blender 5.2 Windows GPU device enumeration hit ze_loader.dll access violation before bake; process tree fully exited. Bounded CPU-only 4096px color bake completed in 12.5s.

candidate2.dependency_and_cage_recheck: Final candidate connects its destination texture only after bake and uses 0.008m cage rather than 0.025m. Circular warning vanished but chimney-adjacent white roof marks did not.

candidate2_derived_2k_color.method: No rebake or geometry changes; LANCZOS downsample only the final 4096px RGBA color atlas and replace the final GLB PNG bufferView
candidate2_derived_2k_color.geometry_uv_indices_nodes_materials_proo: Source and 2K derivative glTF nodes, meshes, accessors and materials compare equal; all geometry/UV/index BIN bytes before the final color PNG are identical SHA c3f2407f1eca8e5faf9f275cd63b60f4d7d5f95b4ae937f3ec50911dd9c71dec.
candidate2_derived_2k_color.status: isolated; 4K source SHA965477e3 unchanged; main game assets untouched

current_decision: The actually adopted 38K LOD0 remains the main game baseline. Root viewed the one-cottage same-world-light 60K/2K off/on front-close, rear-chimney roof-close and street-mid Godot pairs. Window/shutter/flower-box completeness improves, but white roof pick-up near the chimney remains conspicuous in real world lighting. Keep the 60K/2K trial isolated; do not replace the adopted LOD0, and do not continue parameter sweeps.

real_world_single_cottage_ab.root_actual_image_decision: Rear/chimney white roof mark is still prominent; preserve candidate only.

possible_later_fix: A future color-category-aware bake cage or separate chimney/roof projection could avoid ray hits onto white masonry; this was not started inside the bounded two-method trial.
